evals.name: store-author
evals.prompt: The author directory lists all registered authors. Define the stored Author read model.
assertions: Declares AuthorId Id and string Name on Author and identifies AuthorRegistered.Name as the matching string property copied by convention.
Does not mark the listing Passive.

evals.name: remove-one
evals.prompt: Remove an author from the listing when AuthorRemoved arrives. Protect the other author's listing in the test.
evals.expected_output: Removal of only the matching instance.
assertions: Uses the removal feature's AuthorRemoved event in RemovedWith on the listing.
Registers different authors under different IDs.
Checks append acceptance and WaitForCompletion before asserting the surviving author's name and absence of the removed ID.

evals.name: last-change
evals.prompt: Map the time of the last event contributing to an author listing.
evals.expected_output: A timestamp copied from the event context.
assertions: Uses FromEvery on the timestamp member.
Selects EventContext.Occurred as the context property.
Does not substitute the wall clock.
